Site code uses these. A name says what the colour is for.

Action

  • The engine’s primary seed itself (--ig-primary-seed), not a fitted shade.

    More

    The fill of every action: the primary CTA, with color-action-on as its label. Text in the action colour is color-action-text. Contrast 5.25:1 on color-surface-page.

  • Link hover on light surfaces (colour shift only, no underline).

    More

    Contrast 5.41:1 on color-surface-page.

  • Filled-button hover: the primary fill moves to this and nothing else changes.

    More

    A step color-action-on reads on: darker under a white label, primary step 400 under a black one.

  • Inline link press state on light surfaces.

  • The action colour when it is text, an icon or a thin line on a surface: links, eyebrows, outline and ghost button labels, focus outlines.

    More

    An engine step, which the engine solves to the same contrast for any seed. Contrast 5.24:1 on color-surface-page, 4.82:1 on color-surface-tint, 5.24:1 on color-surface-card, 4.98:1 on color-surface-subtle.

  • Label and icon colour on color-action-default fills: black or white, whichever reads on the fill (the engine’s adaptive contrast).

    More

    Contrast 5.25:1 on color-action-default, 7.03:1 on color-action-fill-hover.
